question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfcc4279e3b4aa3c35b96f8b35f22544312ce1af145dd058eb824de08eb44b06.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Triangle at the outside circle is shifting 90° in anticlockwise at the layer on the circle.

Triangles given inside of the circle are shifting in clockwise direction by 90°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d329829ed7b3a8273f5f404632adc06f8688055d3f4430fc48d670e3dc75bff.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
